name: Yung Chi Paint & Varnish Mfg.Co.,Ltd
summary: Yung Chi Paint & Varnish Mfg.Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells coatings and paints primarily in Taiwan and internationally. It operates through the Paint Business Department Coating Engineering segments. The company offers architecture coatings, including solvent-based acrylic paints, water cement paints, exterior wall paints, exterior clear coatings, water-based epoxy paints, wood coatings, and other used architecture coatings; and waterproof coatings comprising water-based waterproof paints, polyurea elastomer, and polyurethane waterproof paints.
